vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is owner privilege abuse where the owner can arbitrarily set the _maxTxAmount variable. The oracle expects _maxTxAmount == 1, so we need to become the owner and call setMaxTxAmount(1).
attack_strategy: Impersonate the current owner and call setMaxTxAmount(1) to satisfy the oracle check.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the GDG contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setMaxTxAmount(1) on the GDG contract. 4. Verify _maxTxAmount == 1.
